notes: «بإسناده» is a back reference; no previous report is supplied in context.
«رواه الثوري بهذا المعنى عن خصيف» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route of this saying.
«حدثنا بذلك مسلم بن إبراهيم» comes after the saying with its own account of the prayer: kept as a separate group.
needs_ruling: two sayings in one report, the second with its own isnad.
«قال أبو داود» is the compiler and is not written.
